question: At sunrise, a beekeeper's storage shed held 138 kilograms of honey, while a magazine article on the counter mentioned a record 900-kilogram harvest from a farm out of state. The morning crew split the honey evenly into six equal drums, and this story follows only the first drum. By midday, 21 kilograms were sold at the farm stand from that drum. In the afternoon, a matching donation from a co-op multiplied the drum's remaining honey fourfold. Later that afternoon, 2 kilograms spilled during transport. By evening, 57 more kilograms were added from a late extraction, but 14 kilograms were set aside for a wedding order. How many kilograms of honey were left in that drum by evening?

Hassan had 76 dollars saved, equal to 7,600 cents as his little sister liked to calculate, and well more than his friend Omar's 20 dollars. A weekend job multiplied his savings eightfold. A bonus from a second gig multiplied it threefold again. He then split the total evenly among four accounts, keeping only the balance in his main account. He deposited another 55 dollars from a birthday gift, but withdrew 344 dollars to buy a used bicycle. How much money was left in Hassan's main account?

Layla had 99 seashells in her collection, far more than her friend Rosa's dozen or so. She found 7 more shells on a beach walk. She then gave away 39 shells to a school art project. A cousin visiting from the coast gave her 56 more shells. Finally, she bought 55 polished shells from a gift shop. How many seashells did Layla have in the end?

A school's supply fund had 125 dollars in it, or 12,500 cents as the treasurer's ledger technically listed it. A classroom expense used up 108 dollars for a field trip deposit. The next day, a bake sale added 45 more dollars, and a parent donation brought in another 15. A matching grant then doubled the fund's entire balance. How much money was in the fund after the grant?

A charity's donation total stood at $125 at the start of the telethon, equal to 12,500 cents on the tally board, while a dozen volunteers manned the phone lines. A matching-donor pledge multiplied the total ninefold right at the top of the broadcast. A local business then called in with $40. Midway through, organizers paid $475 to cover venue costs. A radio station pledged $79, a listener called in with $49, and a final surprise donor added $80 just before the telethon ended. How much money had been raised by the end of the telethon?

In the morning, a blood donation center had 164 pints collected, equal to about 20.5 gallons as the coordinator noted. By midday, another 15 pints came in from a company blood drive. In the afternoon, a local college donated 45 more pints. By evening, a hospital partnership added 40 pints. Late that night, a final mobile unit brought in 77 more pints. How many pints had the center collected by the end of the night?

In the morning, a lemonade stand had 46 cups ready to sell. By midday, the kids had prepared 13 more cups. In the early afternoon, 19 cups were given away free to a passing charity walk. By late afternoon, a neighbor's stand closed early and sent over 32 unsold cups. That evening, a block party multiplied the number of cups sixfold as everyone pitched in to help refill and restock. How many cups did the stand have by the end of the evening?

A movie theater had 231 seats available for a Saturday showing, while a dozen popcorn buckets sat stacked by the door for the concession stand. A group of 46 people bought tickets right away. Then 23 more seats opened up when an earlier showing let out and freed capacity. A last-minute school group booked 161 seats. Finally, 31 more walk-in customers bought tickets. How many seats were still available for that showing?

Kenji had 159 points in a mobile game, well ahead of his rival Sato's 60. A tough boss battle cost him 29 points. He then found a treasure chest worth 56 points. A rare multiplier gem multiplied his entire score ninefold. A second gem, even rarer, multiplied it eightfold again. Finally, a daily login bonus added 76 points. What was Kenji's final score?

A tank at an aquarium held 61 liters of water, or about 16.1 gallons as the tour guide liked to mention. A pump then multiplied the volume sixfold to fill it for a special exhibit. Staff topped it off with 17 more liters by hand. A second, larger tank was filled by tripling this tank's volume into it. Finally, that tank's water was doubled again by connecting a matching reservoir. How many liters of water were in the final tank?

A savings club started the year with $51 in its account, while a dozen new members had just joined that week. A grant multiplied the account sevenfold. Club expenses then used up $251. A second grant multiplied the remaining balance fivefold. A matching corporate donation multiplied it fourfold again. A final anonymous donor multiplied the total ninefold. Then a small interest payment added $27. How much money was in the account at the end of the year?

A food truck had 17 dollars in its tip jar at opening, or 1,700 cents as the owner liked to joke, while a dozen napkins sat in a dispenser nearby. A slow morning cost them 7 dollars in refunds. A lunch rush then multiplied the tip jar eightfold. A card-reader glitch then required refunding 36 dollars to a customer. An evening concert crowd multiplied the tips sevenfold. Finally, the owner split the jar evenly between herself and her business partner, keeping only her half. How many dollars did the owner keep?

In the morning, a school raised 37 balloons for a science demo, while a dozen extra balloons sat in a closet unused. By midday, 28 balloons popped during setup. That afternoon, a helium refill doubled the surviving balloons. Later that afternoon, a nearby classroom donated 66 more balloons. By evening, 72 balloons were released for the finale of the demo. Overnight, a delivery of matching balloons arrived unexpectedly and multiplied the leftover balloons eightfold. The next morning, 85 balloons were used for a follow-up class. How many balloons were left after that class?

A vending company's coin box had $50 in it, equal to 5,000 cents on the accounting sheet. A slot-machine style promotion multiplied the box ninefold for the grand opening. Maintenance costs then used up $295. A customer's returned deposit added $12. The company then paid out $159 for a parts repair. A regional bonus multiplied the remaining balance fivefold, and a final matching grant multiplied it fourfold again. How much money was in the coin box at the end?

A tech startup's promotional fund held 194 dollars on launch day, or 19,400 cents as the finance intern joked while double-checking the ledger. A late sponsor added 19 more dollars. A matching-investor bonus then multiplied the fund sixfold overnight. Server costs the next day ate up 549 dollars. Three back-to-back matching bonuses from partner investors then each multiplied the remaining fund sixfold in turn. How many dollars were in the fund after the three bonuses?

In the morning, a food pantry had 198 pounds of rice in storage, or just under 90 kilograms as the coordinator's inventory sheet also listed it. By midday, a grocery store donated 63 more pounds, even though a news segment that aired mentioned a different pantry receiving 5,000 pounds across the state. In the afternoon, a matching-donation drive multiplied the pantry's rice sixfold. By evening, a community garden added 12 more pounds. Later that evening, a school food drive contributed 63 more pounds. Overnight, a final truck delivery brought in 33 more pounds. How many pounds of rice did the pantry have by morning?

A greenhouse had 57 tomato seedlings at the start of the season. Its irrigation tank held enough water for 210 minutes of misting, or three and a half hours, before needing a refill. A grow-light upgrade multiplied the seedling count fourfold. A second upgrade multiplied it fivefold again. A neighbor gave 7 more seedlings as a gift. A late frost then killed off 657 seedlings. A final greenhouse expansion tripled what remained by adding matching new beds. How many seedlings were in the greenhouse after the expansion?

A school library had 212 books donated at the start of a book drive, while a dozen bookmarks came bundled with the donation boxes as a freebie. A second wave of donations added 56 more books. A third wave brought in 62 more. The librarian then split all the donated books evenly among three classrooms, and this story follows only the first classroom's share. Finally, 19 books from that classroom's share were found damaged and removed. How many books remained in the first classroom's share?

In the morning, a bakery had 79 croissants ready, while a dozen muffins sat untouched on a separate tray. By midday, 33 croissants were sold to a catering order. In the afternoon, a fresh batch from the ovens doubled the remaining croissant count. By evening, a neighboring cafe sent over 74 more croissants after their oven broke down. That night, a wholesale order tripled the total for next-day delivery. How many croissants were ready for next-day delivery?

A charity marathon had 231 registered runners, or just under 2.3 percent of the town's population as the organizer's report noted. A last-minute sponsorship push doubled the registration count. A viral social post then quadrupled that number again. A local running club added 20 more sign-ups. A school team brought in 27 more, and a corporate team added another 26. Finally, a matching city grant multiplied the whole registration count eightfold to fund extra medals. How many runners were registered after the grant?

A candy shop had 52 pounds of gummy bears in stock, or about 23.6 kilograms as the metric scale in back displayed, while a dozen jars of unrelated hard candy sat on a shelf nearby. A supplier delivery multiplied the gummy bear stock fivefold. A second delivery doubled it again. A big order from a party planner then used up 93 pounds. Finally, a weekend of retail sales sold another 50 pounds. How many pounds of gummy bears were left?

Mia had 59 stickers, more than her classmate Jonah's 20. She earned 9 more for finishing her homework early. A teacher gave the whole class 18 more each, so she gained 18. A sticker-trading event multiplied her sheet fivefold. A mishap then cost her 404 stickers when a whole page fell into a puddle. She found 9 more in her backpack. Finally, a bonus round at recess multiplied her remaining stickers sixfold. How many stickers did Mia end up with?

A warehouse had 163 crates of canned soup, while a dozen empty pallets sat stacked in a corner. A bulk order multiplied the crate count ninefold. A shipment of 857 crates then went out to a regional distributor. A matching restock doubled what remained. A late delivery added 71 more crates. A large recall then removed 1,222 crates from the shelves. Finally, a supplier's year-end bonus multiplied the remaining crates eightfold. How many crates were in the warehouse after the bonus?

Ana had 41 buttons in her craft box, more than her sister Rosa's 15. She found 34 more buttons in a sewing kit. A craft-store trade tripled her button collection. A grandmother's gift added 48 more buttons. A club swap event tripled her collection again. Finally, a bulk trade at a fair multiplied her buttons sixfold. How many buttons did Ana have at the end?

A toy store had 236 puzzles in stock, while a completely separate display held 900 board games. A weekend sale sold 57 puzzles. A shipment delay then caused 102 more puzzles to be sent back to the supplier by mistake. A correction shipment brought 68 puzzles back. Finally, a holiday order multiplied the puzzle stock ninefold. How many puzzles were in stock after the holiday order?
